title: Wahala
description: Scenes the game cuts to from anywhere (collapse, raids...). They end with goto "@resume", which returns to the start of the interrupted scene.

cards.title: Your eyes go white.
cards.text: The street tilts. A danfo horn stretches into one long note. Everything goes quiet. Then black.

cards.title: General Hospital Iyana-Wahala
cards.text: Ward C. The fan works on Mondays.

beats.speaker: nurse
beats.text: You don wake? Good. Exhaustion. No food, no rest, too much sun. Lagos don collect your battery.

variants.text: You don wake? Your blood dey smell like Agbára Bitters factory. My brother, those drinks dey borrow energy from tomorrow. Tomorrow don come collect.
You again? Ehn. Next time I go give you loyalty card. Tenth collapse, free drip.

beats.speaker: professor
beats.text: Rule number five: the street no go wait for you. But e no go carry you either. Eat, drink water, sleep. Then hustle.

beats.speaker: nurse
beats.text: Your bill na ₦2,000. Cash or transfer. We no dey collect "I go pay".

options.text: "Nurse, abeg. I go bring am tomorrow."

effects.toast: ₦3,000 added to your debts. Nurse Rónkẹ́ wrote your name in red.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You walk out into the noise. Same street. Same wahala. Small small, you go again.

beats.speaker: nurse
beats.text: Third time. No money. I don call the number for your phone. The one wey you save as "Mama".
